author: Claude taslak (H-071); kullanıcı onayı bekliyor
notes: Anlatım İngilizcede geniş zamanda (present simple); Türkçede doğal anlatım için çoğunlukla şimdiki zaman (-iyor) kullanıldı.
"Grandpa" Türkçede "Dede" olarak çevrildi (Kemal Dede). Emir kipleri (Touch here. Smile.) Türkçede de emir: "Buraya dokun. Gülümse."
Kelime anlamları cümledeki kullanıma göre verildi; -s takısı olan fiillerde (lives, has, touches) not düşüldü.

lines.en: And he has a new phone.
lines.tr: Bir de yeni bir telefonu var.

lines.en: This week, Grandpa has one job.
lines.tr: Bu hafta Dede'nin tek bir görevi var.

lines.en: On Saturday, it is Ece's birthday.
Grandpa wants to send her one nice photo.
lines.tr: Dede ona güzel bir fotoğraf göndermek istiyor.

lines.en: But the new phone does everything wrong.
lines.tr: Ama yeni telefon her şeyi yanlış yapıyor.

lines.en: On Monday morning, Grandpa sits on his sofa.
"Call Ece," he says to the phone.

words.that: o, şu (is that you: sen misin)

lines.en: On Tuesday, Grandpa opens his window.
He lives on the same floor.
His window has a blue curtain.
Today Mert's flat is full of noise.
Grandpa wants a photo of the city.
But the photo is not the city.
Then the phone makes a happy noise.
lines.tr: Sonra telefon neşeli bir ses çıkarıyor.

lines.en: On Wednesday, Grandpa goes to the park.
They drink tea and play a game.
Then music comes from his pocket.
Now he has photos of his ear.
In the evening, the phone rings.
On Thursday morning, the bell rings.
Can I help with your phone?"
Mert is not in the park on Wednesday.
lines.tr: Mert çarşamba günü parkta değil ki.

lines.en: They sit at the kitchen table.
It is a good photo of Mert.
Touch the green button, not the red one."
On Friday, Grandpa tries again alone.
lines.tr: Cuma günü Dede tek başına yeniden deniyor.

lines.en: But then he touches something new.
lines.tr: Ama sonra yeni bir şeye dokunuyor.

lines.en: There are many faces on the phone.
Ece, her mum, her dad and Uncle Murat!
lines.tr: Ece, annesi, babası ve Murat Amca!

lines.en: Every face has a blue curtain behind it.
lines.tr: Her yüzün arkasında mavi bir perde var.
"Neden her şey mavi?" diye soruyor Dede.

lines.en: In the evening, Grandpa sits at his window.

words.lot: çok (a lot of: çok, bir sürü)

lines.en: On Saturday morning, Grandpa wears his best shirt.
lines.tr: Cumartesi sabahı Dede en güzel gömleğini giyiyor.

lines.en: He has yellow flowers for the photo.
He holds the flowers and the phone.
It is Grandpa with the flowers.
Behind the door, there are many happy noises.
lines.tr: Kapının arkasından bir sürü neşeli ses geliyor.

lines.en: Ece is there with her mum and dad.
Uncle Murat and the cousins are there.
lines.tr: Murat Amca ve kuzenler de orada.

lines.en: The man from the bread shop is there.
He has a very big cake.
"But it is your birthday, Ece," says Grandpa.
lines.tr: "Ama doğum günü senin, Ece," diyor Dede.

lines.en: And I want my birthday here.
"We are in Mert's flat all week!"
And your phone is my job."
The family carries the party into the flat.
On the wall, there are many photos.
"Your phone sends us every photo," says Ece.
lines.tr: "Telefonun bize bütün fotoğrafları gönderiyor," diyor Ece.

lines.en: But the family loves the photos.
Grandpa shows them his nice photo.
His new phone does everything wrong.
lines.tr: Yeni telefonu her şeyi yanlış yapıyor.

phrases.note: Türk öğrenciye not: "telefonu açmak" İngilizcede "open the phone" değil, "answer the phone"dur.
Emir kipi: fiilin yalın hâli (Touch, Smile, Look, Come in).
can ile soru: Can + özne + fiil.
